<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(frame):
    seg=frame.segmentation; out=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'RbNM' and n['pixels']>=16:
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            out.append((n['color'],min(rows),min(cols),max(cols)))
    # beam extent: w/g nodes in rows 20-21
    bc=set()
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'wg':
            r0=n['boundary'][0][0]
            if 19<=r0<=22:
                for p in n['boundary']: bc.add(p[1])
    return sorted(out), (min(bc),max(bc)) if bc else None
for i in range(2):
    action(['LEFT'])
    s,bc=snap(current_frame)
    print('LEFT',i+1,':',s,'beam cols:',bc, last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def snap(frame):
    seg=frame.segmentation; out=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'RbNM' and n['pixels']>=16:
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            out.append((n['color'],min(rows),min(cols),max(cols)))
    # beam extent: w/g nodes in rows 20-21
    bc=set()
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'wg':
            r0=n['boundary'][0][0]
            if 19<=r0<=22:
                for p in n['boundary']: bc.add(p[1])
    return sorted(out), (min(bc),max(bc)) if bc else None
for i in range(2):
    action(['LEFT'])
    s,bc=snap(current_frame)
    print('LEFT',i+1,':',s,'beam cols:',bc, last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
